analyze.ai_caveat: These win rates come from a scripted AI; for combo decks they are a floor on the deck, not a ceiling.

coach.empty: Too few games with these cards to claim anything.
coach.intro: Computed from instrumented simulations of this deck: for each card, the win rate of the games it reached you in, against the matchup’s own win rate.
coach.note: Deltas are correlational estimates from simulations with a scripted AI.
coach.sample: Measured over {games} games against each deck in the field; a card needs {n} appearances in a matchup to be listed.
deck.label: Your deck code (in game: Deck → Copy)
meta.caveat_noisy: At {games} games per pair a single matchup carries roughly ±{margin} points of noise, which is wider than the tier bands. Treat this run as a shape, not a ranking — raise the games per pair to narrow it.
meta.caveat_not_ladder: This is the simulator playing itself, not the ladder. TavernLab does not scrape HSReplay or Untapped for winrates, so it cannot tell you what is strong in ranked play.
meta.caveat_scripted_ai: The AI is scripted. Combo and value-engine decks come out below their real strength; treat their numbers as a lower bound.
meta.caveat_skipped: {n} deck(s) are outside this table because the simulator cannot field them: {decks}.
meta.caveat_small_field: The field is the gauntlet, not a ladder’s long tail. A deck that beats it is not thereby the best deck in the game.

optimize.confirmed: Every kept swap was re-measured on its own {games} games per opponent: the first pass only picks candidates, and its figure is inflated by taking the maximum.
optimize.none: No clear improvements — the deck is tight.
